name: M82, SN 2014J field (Hubble)
blurb: M82, the Cigar Galaxy, at the site of supernova SN 2014J, seen by Hubble.
label: sn2014jhost-hubble
story: This field frames the part of M82, the Cigar Galaxy, where SN 2014J, a Type Ia supernova, was discovered. M82 is a starburst galaxy, and Hubble returned here as part of a survey of the sites of recent, nearby supernovae.

claims.text: SN 2014J is a Type Ia supernova
M82 is the Cigar Galaxy, a starburst galaxy
Program 15166 is a snapshot survey of the sites of recent nearby supernovae and includes SN2014J
